total_rate_definition: Match the spatial mean of the legacy injection at the baseline grid, width and source; retain that same synthetic in-FOV input per second across every new profile.
boundary_convention: New profiles condition the Gaussian input on the unit FOV; normalization redistributes truncated outside input inside the FOV. This is a declared synthetic convention, not a physical boundary model.
scope: Source-input audit only. No transport, observation, estimator, scan-policy, physical calibration or joint inference result. Grid shapes above 24x32 are input-only quadrature probes, not full-covariance filtering runs.
